--- a/tenacity/retry.py
+++ b/tenacity/retry.py
@@ -166,16 +166,22 @@
 class retry_if_exception_cause_type(retry_base):
     """Retries if any of the causes of the raised exception is of one or more types.
 
-    The check on the type of the cause of the exception is done recursively (until finding
-    an exception in the chain that has no ``__cause__``, or a cycle is detected).
+    By default, only explicit ``__cause__`` links are followed. With
+    ``include_context=True``, an unsuppressed ``__context__`` is followed when
+    there is no explicit cause. Linked exceptions are checked recursively until
+    the chain ends or a cycle is detected; the initial exception is not checked
+    merely because it was raised.
     """
 
     def __init__(
         self,
         exception_types: type[BaseException]
         | tuple[type[BaseException], ...] = Exception,
+        *,
+        include_context: bool = False,
     ) -> None:
         self.exception_cause_types = exception_types
+        self.include_context = include_context
 
     @override
     def __call__(self, retry_state: "RetryCallState") -> bool:
@@ -184,15 +190,24 @@
 
         if retry_state.outcome.failed:
             exc = retry_state.outcome.exception()
-            # Guard against cyclic __cause__ chains (e.g. ``raise e from e``),
+            # Guard against cyclic cause/context chains (e.g. ``raise e from e``),
             # which would otherwise spin forever inside the predicate and
             # prevent stop conditions from ever running (see #658).
             seen: set[int] = set()
             while exc is not None and id(exc) not in seen:
                 seen.add(id(exc))
-                if isinstance(exc.__cause__, self.exception_cause_types):
+                linked = exc.__cause__
+                if (
+                    linked is None
+                    and self.include_context
+                    and not exc.__suppress_context__
+                ):
+                    linked = exc.__context__
+                if linked is None:
+                    break
+                if isinstance(linked, self.exception_cause_types):
                     return True
-                exc = exc.__cause__
+                exc = linked
 
         return False

+++ b/tests/test_cause_context.py
@@ -0,0 +1,65 @@
+import pytest
+
+from tenacity import Future, RetryCallState, Retrying, retry_if_exception_cause_type
+
+
+def state_for(exc):
+    state = RetryCallState(Retrying(), None, (), {})
+    state.outcome = Future.construct(1, exc, True)
+    return state
+
+
+def test_default_still_ignores_implicit_context():
+    exc = RuntimeError("outer")
+    exc.__context__ = ValueError("inner")
+    policy = retry_if_exception_cause_type(ValueError)
+    assert policy(state_for(exc)) is False
+
+
+def test_opt_in_follows_multiple_implicit_links():
+    root = RuntimeError("outer")
+    middle = LookupError("middle")
+    root.__context__ = middle
+    middle.__context__ = ValueError("inner")
+    policy = retry_if_exception_cause_type(ValueError, include_context=True)
+    assert policy(state_for(root)) is True
+
+
+def test_explicit_cause_takes_precedence_over_context():
+    root = RuntimeError("outer")
+    root.__cause__ = LookupError("explicit")
+    root.__context__ = ValueError("implicit")
+    policy = retry_if_exception_cause_type(ValueError, include_context=True)
+    assert policy(state_for(root)) is False
+    root.__cause__.__context__ = ValueError("deeper")
+    assert policy(state_for(root)) is True
+
+
+def test_suppressed_context_and_root_are_not_matches():
+    policy = retry_if_exception_cause_type(ValueError, include_context=True)
+    root = ValueError("outer")
+    assert policy(state_for(root)) is False
+    root.__context__ = ValueError("inner")
+    root.__suppress_context__ = True
+    assert policy(state_for(root)) is False
+
+
+def test_cycles_terminate_but_matching_link_still_counts():
+    root = RuntimeError("outer")
+    middle = LookupError("middle")
+    root.__context__ = middle
+    middle.__context__ = root
+    policy = retry_if_exception_cause_type(ValueError, include_context=True)
+    assert policy(state_for(root)) is False
+    middle.__context__ = ValueError("inner")
+    middle.__context__.__cause__ = root
+    assert policy(state_for(root)) is True
+
+
+def test_success_and_unset_outcomes_keep_existing_contract():
+    policy = retry_if_exception_cause_type(ValueError, include_context=True)
+    state = RetryCallState(Retrying(), None, (), {})
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
+        policy(state)
+    state.set_result("ok")
+    assert policy(state) is False
